what: change in net approval between the reading around the midterm and June of the election year, points; from the approval record in fifty-two-keys/research.json

effect_on_the_forecast_of_2026-11-25.what: the official method run with the allowance at 10, 15 and 20 points; measured after the recommendation was written, and not a reason for it

what_the_measures_are: mean: the average change, with its sign. mean_abs: the average size of the change. median_abs: the middle size. sd: the standard deviation about the mean. rms: the root of the mean squared change, which is the spread about no change at all. The forecast assumes no trend, so the allowance is a spread about no change and rms is the measure it should be set against. 'within' counts the terms whose change was no larger than 10, 15 or 20; if the allowance is right about two terms in three fall within it.
